description: This file defines a generic decorator class for caching catalog lookup data in local storage, using Blazor and dependency injection. It implements cache retrieval and refresh logic for lookup data, integrating with local storage and logging services.

classes.name: CachedCatalogLookupDataServiceDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds in-memory caching logic to a catalog lookup data service, leveraging local storage and logging.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of lookup data, checking local storage for cache validity, and refreshes data if cache is expired.
